questions.question: The average of 19 numbers is 24. The average of the first 8 numbers is 26.5 and that of the last 12 numbers is 21.5. If the 8th number is excluded, then what will be the average (correct to one decimal point) of the remaining numbers?
questions.solution:
Given:

The average of 19 numbers is 24. 

The average of the first 8 numbers is 26.5 and that of the last 12 numbers is 21.5.

Concept used:

Total = Average × Number of entities

Calculation:

Sum of the first 8 numbers i.e. 1st + 2nd + .... + 8th

⇒ 26.5 × 8 = 212

Sum of the last 12 numbers i.e. 19th + 18th + ... + 8th

⇒ 21.5 × 12 = 258

Sum of all 19 numbers i.e. (1st + 2nd + ... + 8th + ... + 19th)

⇒ 19 × 24 = 456

According to the question,

(1st + 2nd + .... + 8th) + (19th + 18th + ... + 8th) = 212 + 258

⇒ (1st + 2nd + ... + 8th + ... + 19th) + 8th = 470

⇒ (1st + 2nd + ... + 8th + ... + 19th) + 8th = 470

⇒ 456 + 8th = 470

⇒ 8th = 470 - 456

⇒ 8th = 14

Now, excluding the 8th number, the average

⇒ (456 - 14) ÷ (19 - 1)

⇒ 442/18

⇒ 24.55 ≈ 24.6

∴ Excluding the 8th number, the average will be 24.6.

questions.question: The average weight of 24 persons in a group is 72 kg. If 3 persons with average weight 78 kg leave the group and 4 persons of average weight 75 kg join the group, then what will be the average weight (in kg) of the persons in the group now?
questions.solution:
Given:

The average weight of 24 persons in a group is 72 kg

3 persons with average weight 78 kg leave and 4 persons of average weight 75 kg join the group

Formula Used:

Average = (Sum of the observations/Number of observations)

Calculation:

According to question,

Average weight = 72 kg

Number of persons = 24

Sum of total weight = 72 × 24 

⇒ Sum of total weight = 1728 Kg

Now Sum of total weight of persons who left = 78 × 3

⇒ 234 Kg

Now Sum of total weight of persons who join = 75 × 4

⇒ 300 Kg

Total weight of the persons present in the group = (1728 + 300 - 234) Kg

⇒ 1794 Kg

Number of persons present in the group = 24 + 4 - 3

⇒ 25

Average = Total weight/Number of persons 

⇒ Average = 1794/25

⇒ 71.76 Kg

**∴ The average weight (in kg) of the persons in the group now is 71.76 Kg.**

questions.question: The average weight of 56 students in a group is 55 kg. If 12 students of average weight 60 kg leave and 6 students of average weight 52.5 kg join the group, then the average weight of the remaining students in the group decreased by:
questions.solution:
Given:

Average weight of 56 students in a group is 55 kg

12 students of average weight 60 kg leave and 6 students of average weight 52.5 kg join the group

Formula Used:

Average = Sum of weights/Number of students

Calculations:

Average weight of class = 55 kg

Number of students = 56

Total weight of the class = 55 × 56

⇒ 3080 Kg

Average Weight of 12 old students leaving the group = 60 Kg

Total weight of 12 students = 12 × 60

⇒ 720 Kg

Average Weight of 6 new students joining the group = 52.5 kg

Total weight of 6 new students joining the group = 52.5 × 6

⇒ 315 Kg

Total weight of the class now = 3080 - 720 + 315

⇒ 2675 Kg

Number of student left in the class = (56 - 12 + 6)

⇒ 50

New average weight = 2675/50 = 53.5 Kg

Average weight is decreased = (55 - 53.5) Kg

⇒ 1.5 Kg

**∴ The average weight of the remaining students in the group decreased by 1.5 Kg.**

questions.question: The average weight of 6 persons increases by 2.5 kg when a new person comes in place of one of them weighing 55 kg. What might be the weight (in kg) of the new person?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The average weight of 6 persons increases by 2.5 kg when a new person comes in place of one of them weighing 55 kg

**Concept used:**

Weight of new person = Weight of the person being replaced + Total change in weight 

**Calculation:**

Weight of the person replaced = 55 kg

Total change in weight due to new person = 2.5 kg per person for 6 people

Total change in weight due to new person = (2.5 × 6) = 15 kg

Weight of the new person = (55 + 15) kg

⇒ 70 kg

**∴ Weight of the new person is 70 kg**

questions.question: The average weight of all the students in a class is 55 kg. The ratio of the average weight of boys to that of girls is 5 : 4. If 40% of the students are boys and the rest are girls, then what is the average weight (in kg) of boys?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Ratio of number of boys to girls = 40% : 60% = 2 : 3.

Let their respective average weights be 5 units and 4 units.

Combined average = (2 × 5 + 3 × 4) ÷ (2 + 3) = 22/5 units.

Given combined average = 55 kg ⇒ 22/5 units = 55 ⇒ 1 unit = (55 × 5) ÷ 22 = 12.5 kg.

Average weight of boys = 5 units = 5 × 12.5 = 62.5 kg.

**∴ The correct answer is 62.5 kg.**

questions.question: The average of 12 numbers is 25.5. The average of the first six numbers is 22.4 and that of the last three numbers is 28.2. The 7th number is 5 less than the 8th number but 10 less than the 9th number. What is the average of the 8th and 9th numbers?
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Net deviation of first 6 and last 3 numbers = 6 × (22.4 − 25.5) + 3 × (28.2 − 25.5) = −18.6 + 8.1 = −10.5.

To balance the deviation, sum of the remaining three numbers (7th, 8th, 9th) = 3 × 25.5 + 10.5 = 87.

Let the 8th number = x, then 7th = x − 5, and 9th = x + 5.

Sum = x − 5 + x + x + 5 = 3x = 87 ⇒ x = 29.

The 8th number is 29 and the 9th number is 29 + 5 = 34.

**∴ The correct answer is 31.5.**

questions.question: The average of 19 numbers is 48. The average of the first 7 numbers is 50.6 and that of the last 13 numbers is 47.6. If the 7th number is excluded, then what is the average of the remaining numbers (correct to one decimal place)?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The average of 19 numbers = 48

The average of the first 7 numbers = 50.6

The average of last 13 numbers = 47.6

**Formula used:**

Average = sum of observations/Number of observations

**Calculation:**

The average of 19 numbers = (19 × 48) = 912

The average of the first 7 numbers = (7 × 50.6) = 354.2

The average of last 13 numbers = (13 × 47.6) = 618.8

Now,

7th number = (618.8 + 354.2 – 912)

⇒ (973 – 912)

⇒ 61

Sum of remaining 18 numbers = (912 – 61) = 851

The average of the remaining numbers = (851/18)

⇒ 47.3

**∴ The required average is 47.3**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] __Alternate Method__**Let a₁, a₂......a₁₉ are the number

⇒ a₁ + a₂ + ...a₁₉ = (19 × 48) = 912 ----(1)

⇒ a1 + a2 + ...a₇ = (7 × 50.6) = 354.2 ----(2)

⇒ a₇ + a₈ + ...a₁₉ = (13 × 47.6) = 618.8 ----(3)

Adding equation (2) and (3)

⇒ a₁ + a₂ + ..a₇ + a₇ + .....a₁₉ = 354.2 + 618.8 = 973

⇒ a₇ + a₁ + a₂ + .....a19 = 973

⇒ a₇ + 912= 973 [From (1)]

⇒ a7 = 61

Hecne new sum = 912 - 61 = 851

**∴ New average = 851/18 = 47.3**
